content: Agent (Infiltrator) Even Aliens hate their jobs . Invasion Series (Comedy) .  Bill Johnson leads a rather sedentary life, he works his dead end bank job in uptown charlotte giving him the ability to walk home to his overpriced loft with its nosy neighbors to the small piece of paradise which he shares with his cat mittens, he watches TV and owns an old ford sedan, in fact there is absolutely nothing remarkable about Bill, except that he is an Alien infiltrator sent here to prepare the world for invasion . But Bill likes earth, he loves reality TV and  fast food , over the years he has come to hate his part in the global conspiracy to weaken governments and economies paving the way for domination by his race.  Partnering with his crazy conspiracy theory neighbor Bill decides to throw a wrench into the plan and the two set out to stop the subjugation of Earth by his own people.  Besides he still hasn’t finished Game of Thrones yet…   There are Hundreds of Aliens Among us.  The conspiracy runs deep and extends to every facet of everyday life, Bill is a minor player in a large dark game to end the world .  Bill Johnson Bank Employee – boring guy Bill is a bland man with a bland life, but hides a dark secret, he is really an alien and over the years has decided he likes earth and doesn’t want to see it end. He needs to find a way to stop his people from ending his home .  Marty Reyes Conspiracy Theory Nut Mary Lives next door to Bill, he knows there is something off about the man but has never been able to prove it, he also knows the vapor trails, black helicopters and high fructose corn syrup placed upon the planet by Satan are real. When Bill approaches him to aid him in saving the world, Marty can’t say no
